ratings.notes: Devoted relates to loyalty; unfaithful relates to disloyalty/betrayal (IngroupVice, AuthorityVice).
Fearmongering relates to causing harm (Care vice); reassuring relates to preventing harm (Care virtue).
Genocidal is extreme harm (Care vice) and a general vice.
White knight relates to protection (Care virtue); bad boy relates to defiance (Authority vice) and general badness.
Yes-man implies deference to authority; contrarian implies defiance of authority and valuing liberty.
Giving relates to kindness and benefit (Care virtue).
Frank relates to honesty (Fairness virtue, General virtue); sugarcoated implies dishonesty.
